name: erenumab
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE AIMOVIG is indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults. AIMOVIG is a calcitonin gene-related peptide receptor antagonist indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults. ( 1 )
pediatric: 8.4 Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established.
contra: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS AIMOVIG is contraindicated in patients with serious hypersensitivity to erenumab-aooe or to any of the excipients.
